LAST COMMAND (formerly FRACTURE LINE) — Milestone 2.6 (skirmish: EU Alliance, TPLA and United States).
Design, code, procedural 3D models (M2.6 model upgrade with automatic LODs), weathering and surface-detail shaders, decals, effects, maps, faction HUD themes, UI and text: original work made for Malachi Murphy with Grok Bot. US unit names are original and only inspired by real equipment roles.
Textures: ambientCG (ambientcg.com), CC0 1.0 public domain — Ground097, Ground109, Grass004, Rock063, Asphalt033, Gravel035, Concrete034, CorrugatedSteel005, Rust004; winter: Snow006, Ground054, Snow004, Rock035, Ice002, Snow010A; temperate: Grass001, Ground037, Rock023, PavingStones130; arid: Ground090, Ground102, Rock061, Ground079S.
Soldier models and animations: Quaternius, "Toon Shooter Game Kit" (quaternius.com), CC0 1.0 public domain — recoloured and re-equipped per faction, re-proportioned, decimated and baked to vertex animation.
Sound effects and music ("Dust Over Varno", "Steel Rain"): original, synthesized for this game.
Voices (AI-generated, original lines, no real person's voice cloned):
• EU and US: Kokoro-82M speech model (hexgrad, Apache-2.0) via kokoro-onnx (MIT); phonemes by eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0 build tool, only audio ships).
• TPLA (English with Middle Eastern accents): Chatterbox Multilingual (Resemble AI, MIT; output carries Resemble's Perth audio watermark), prompted with synthetic speakers derived from Piper Persian voices amir, ganji and reza_ibrahim (CC0 datasets, but fine-tuned from Piper's research-only "lessac" voice — licence not clearly permissive; these TPLA voices will be replaced in a later update; Piper GPL-3.0 build tool only). Checked with faster-whisper / Whisper (MIT).
Your own recordings in audio/voice replace the AI voices.
